info.title: Sprint 1 Smart Lab and Room Booking API
info.description: Sprint 1 backend with Microsoft Graph one-way creation, rescheduling and cancellation of confirmed bookings. Confirmed events invite the student and the corresponding room/equipment calendar. Outlook credentials must be configured locally; sync status is independent of booking status. University SSO and durable database remain adapter integration points. Waitlists and recurrence are deferred to Sprint 2. Demo authentication and memory data are local-development-only. All paths retain trailing slashes; request timestamps require offsets and responses use UTC Z.

post.summary: Create a room or individual equipment booking request
post.description: Requires an induction submission for the resource. Valid VERIFIED qualification plus no approved conflict results in APPROVED. PENDING evidence with no conflict results in WAITING_QUALIFICATION for up to 24 hours; existing conflicts result in PENDING_APPROVAL immediately. HTTP 201 alone does not mean the booking is approved. Pending requests do not occupy slots. Interval semantics are [start, end). If the requested start is at or before the 24-hour threshold, unverified requests enter PENDING_APPROVAL immediately. Unapproved requests expire when their start time is reached.
